use_case: AI document extraction assistant: reads client source documents (Forms W-2 and 1099, K-1s, brokerage statements) and fills return input fields in SYS-T1
vendor_or_model: Hosted generative model from a third-party model provider, called by an in-house extraction service (U.S.-only processing, no training, no human review of content, 30-day deletion by contract)
build_or_buy: Build (in-house service on a bought model)
data_categories: Tax return information: source documents with SSNs, income, and account numbers (Restricted)
consequential_decision_category: None directly (tax preparation is not a consequential decision category); errors can change a client's tax liability
human_in_the_loop: Preparer verifies every extracted field against the source before the return goes to review; reviewer signs off; CPA or enrolled agent signs the return
applicable_laws: N54-R02 (301.7216-2(d)(1): auxiliary services without substantive determinations; counsel memo 2025-05 to be reconfirmed); N54-R01 (314.4(c)(4), (f)); 31 CFR 10.22; FTC Act Sec. 5 for any accuracy claims (N51-R01)
status: In production (6,400 preparers; about 1.9 million returns in 2026); continues with conditions (P10 section 6)
division: CPA and Tax Services (Tax and Advisory)

use_case: Tax drafting assistant: proposes tax treatments and drafts explanations for preparers
vendor_or_model: Hosted generative model (same model provider as AI-001) with an in-house retrieval layer over firm guidance
build_or_buy: Build (in-house service on a bought model)
data_categories: Tax return information and preparer prompts (Restricted)
consequential_decision_category: None directly; outputs are substantive tax determinations that a practitioner adopts or rejects
human_in_the_loop: CPA or enrolled agent must review and document the basis for any treatment the tool proposes; reviewer cannot sign off on an AI treatment without a cited authority
applicable_laws: N54-R02 (301.7216-2(d)(1) does not cover substantive determinations; consent under 301.7216-3 or no tax return information in prompts); 31 CFR 10.22 (due diligence; reliance on others); N54-R01 (314.4(c)(7))
status: Pilot (300 preparers since 2026-03); restricted to prompts without client tax return information from 2026-10-15 (POAM-011)
division: CPA and Tax Services (Tax and Advisory)

use_case: Notice response drafting: drafts replies to IRS and state tax notices for representation staff
vendor_or_model: Same hosted model and retrieval layer as AI-002
build_or_buy: Build (in-house service on a bought model)
data_categories: Notices and related tax return information (Restricted)
consequential_decision_category: None directly; supports representation before the IRS
human_in_the_loop: The CPA or enrolled agent representing the client reviews, edits, and signs every response
status: Pilot (40 representation staff); same restriction as AI-002 until the consent and counsel review are complete
division: CPA and Tax Services (Tax and Advisory)

use_case: Audit analytics and document testing tool: full-population journal entry analytics and AI-assisted reading of contracts and invoices on attest engagements
business_owner: CPA Partners risk and quality partner
vendor_or_model: Audit analytics software vendor with an embedded generative model (no-training terms)
data_categories: Audit client financial data; for about 85 health care clients, PHI in sampled documents
human_in_the_loop: Engagement team evaluates every flagged item; the engagement partner remains responsible for conclusions under professional standards
applicable_laws: N54-R06 (HIPAA business associate duties: PHI only where the BAA and the vendor agreement permit); N54-R08 (confidential client information; professional standard, not law)
status: In production (registered in the inventory late, in 2026-06)

use_case: Adviser meeting notes and summary assistant: records client meetings and drafts summaries and follow-up tasks for the CRM
vendor_or_model: Meeting assistant vendor with a hosted generative model (no-training terms; vendor is a Regulation S-P service provider)
data_categories: Meeting audio and transcripts; client financial information (Wealth customer information)
consequential_decision_category: None directly; summaries may record client instructions and risk tolerance that later support advice
human_in_the_loop: Adviser reviews, edits, and approves every summary before it is saved; recording starts only after every party consents
applicable_laws: N52-R05 (248.30(a)(5) service provider oversight); 17 CFR 275.204-2(a)(7) (written communications kept in the archive); 275.206(4)-7 (annual review); state recording consent laws (Fla. Stat. 934.03(2)(d) worked example)
status: Pilot (400 advisers); no expansion until summaries are archived (POAM-019)

use_case: Client service email drafting for Wealth service associates
vendor_or_model: Enterprise AI assistant (AI-009 platform) with approved prompts
human_in_the_loop: Associates review and send every email; money movement requests are never handled by the tool
applicable_laws: N52-R05; 17 CFR 275.204-2(a)(7) (emails are archived through the normal channel); POL-05 4.5 call-back rule

use_case: AI document intake: classifies and extracts data from client documents uploaded to customer firms' portals in Practice Cloud
vendor_or_model: Hosted generative model from a third-party model provider (no training; U.S. region set in configuration only)
data_categories: Customer firms' client documents, including tax return information (customer data)
consequential_decision_category: None directly; customer firms' preparers rely on the extracted data
human_in_the_loop: Customer firm staff review extracted data in the workflow before use; the feature is off unless the customer opts in
applicable_laws: N54-R02 (Practice Cloud as auxiliary-services preparer, 301.7216-2(d)(1); 301.7216-3(b)(4) U.S. processing); N54-R01 (customers' 314.4(f) oversight duties); SOC 2 commitments (CC2.3, CC3.4, CC8.1, CC9.2); N51-R01 FTC Act Sec. 5 (the "99% accurate" claim); customer agreements (sub-processor notice)
status: In production for 2,300 opt-in customer firms; new enrollments paused until conditions are met (POAM-020, POAM-021)

use_case: Engineering coding assistant for Practice Cloud engineers
data_categories: Source code; no customer data permitted
human_in_the_loop: Engineers review all suggestions; normal code review and security testing apply

use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant for the workforce (drafting and summarizing internal documents)
vendor_or_model: Enterprise AI assistant (no-training terms; U.S. processing)
data_categories: Internal documents; Restricted information only for approved roles and only in the enterprise tenant
human_in_the_loop: Users review all outputs; prohibited for tax treatments, investment recommendations, and attest conclusions
